<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915758_theRebbe_412" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915758_theRebbe_412__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section contains the header and date of the maamar, including the Torah portion and the eve of Chanukah 5726.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">Shabbos Parshas Vayeishev,</t>
    <t s="2">Erev Chanukah,</t>
    <t s="3">5726</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that Chanukah candles differ from the Temple Menorah in number, location, and time, and questions why the mitzvah is specifically outdoors.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">To understand the matter of Chanukah candles,</t>
    <t s="1">that although the Chanukah candles were instituted because of the miracle that occurred with the candles of the Temple,</t>
    <t s="2">and whatever the Sages instituted is in the manner of Torah law they instituted,</t>
    <t s="3">nevertheless, they differ in several matters.</t>
    <t s="4">In their number—</t>
    <t s="5">for in the Menorah in the Temple there were seven candles,</t>
    <t s="6">and the Chanukah candles are eight.</t>
    <t s="7">In their place of standing—</t>
    <t s="8">for the Menorah was inside</t>
    <t s="9">(within the Sanctuary)</t>
    <t s="10">and in the south</t>
    <t s="11">(right side),</t>
    <t s="12">and the Chanukah candles are commanded to be placed outside</t>
    <t s="13">and on the left.</t>
    <t s="14">And in the time of their lighting—</t>
    <t s="15">for the Temple candles were lit from the time of the afternoon offering,</t>
    <t s="16">a duration of time</t>
    <t s="17">(an hour and a quarter)</t>
    <t s="18">before sunset,</t>
    <t s="19">and the mitzvah of the Chanukah candle is from sunset.</t>
    <t s="20">And adds my revered father-in-law, the Rebbe,</t>
    <t s="21">(in the continuation of "Padeh BeShalom" 5704)</t>
    <t s="22">another precision in this: that the Chanukah candle is commanded to be placed outside,</t>
    <t s="23">for we do not find a mitzvah</t>
    <t s="24">(except for the Red Heifer)</t>
    <t s="25">that must be outside</t>
    <t s="26">(the public domain)</t>
    <t s="27">specifically.</t>
    <t s="28">And he explains in the continuation,</t>
    <t s="29">that the simple reason for this, that the Chanukah candle is outside, is for the sake of publicizing the miracle.</t>
    <t s="30">But at first glance this reason is insufficient,</t>
    <t s="31">for the miracle of Purim is also publicized through a festive meal, sending portions, and gifts to the poor,</t>
    <t s="32">and nevertheless, this is not done in the public domain.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that Chanukah candles illuminate the darkness of the public domain, representing a light above the chain of descent, hence eight candles.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">B)</t>
    <t s="1">And the point of the explanation in this is</t>
    <t s="2">(as explained in the discourses),</t>
    <t s="3">that the matter of Chanukah candles is to illuminate the darkness.</t>
    <t s="4">For through the war of the Greeks to cause them to forget Your Torah and to make them transgress the statutes of Your will,</t>
    <t s="5">[and particularly after they entered the Sanctuary and defiled all the oils in the Sanctuary],</t>
    <t s="6">there was a strengthening of the darkness of the side of impurity,</t>
    <t s="7">and therefore,</t>
    <t s="8">when the kingdom of the Chashmonaim prevailed and they defeated the Greeks, they instituted the Chanukah candles,</t>
    <t s="9">in order to illuminate the darkness.</t>
    <t s="10">And this is why their lighting time is from sunset,</t>
    <t s="11">for their matter is to illuminate the darkness.</t>
    <t s="12">And their place of standing is outside</t>
    <t s="13">(the public domain)</t>
    <t s="14">and on the left,</t>
    <t s="15">in order to also illuminate the darkness of the public domain,</t>
    <t s="16">the "mountains of separation,"</t>
    <t s="17">whose nourishment is from the left side.</t>
    <t s="18">And this is why the Chanukah candles are eight candles,</t>
    <t s="19">for that the Chanukah candles illuminate the darkness</t>
    <t s="20">(even the darkness of the public domain)</t>
    <t s="21">is because the light of the Chanukah candles is a light that is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="22">and therefore they are eight candles,</t>
    <t s="23">for the number eight indicates a level that is above the chain of descent.</t>
    <t s="24">And likewise regarding the festival of Chanukah,</t>
    <t s="25">that the festival of Chanukah is eight days</t>
    <t s="26">(the days of Chanukah are eight),</t>
    <t s="27">it is,</t>
    <t s="28">because the revelation that shines during the days of Chanukah is a revelation that is above the chain of descent.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
